name: Hiwot
before: [unsteady] I can breathe. I thought I would never...
text: [unsteady] My hands. I can feel them again. Hold on. My knees are not quite ready.
spokenText: [unsteady] My hands. I can feel them again. Hold on. My knees are not quite ready.

name: Hiwot
before: [impressed] He BELIEVED you. Olamide's name still opens doors. Third floor, he says. Do not touch anything.
text: [impressed] That worked. Olamide's name got us in. Third floor. Keep your hands to yourself; he is still watching.
spokenText: [impressed] That worked. The mage's name got us in. Third floor. Keep your hands to yourself; he is still watching.

name: Hiwot
text: [quick] Watch my knife. I am going round him.
spokenText: [quick] Watch my knife. I am going round him.

name: Desmond
before: [sing-song] You hear that, Winston? We have friends now. — No worry yourself, {target}. I bite only the ones you tell me to.
text: [sing-song] You hear that, Winston? We have friends now. Stay close, {target}. I'll keep the fire off you.
spokenText: [sing-song] You hear that? We have friends now. Stay close. I'll keep the fire off you.

name: Desmond
text: [soft] You grew up here? Show me which windows they leave open.
spokenText: [soft] You grew up here? Show me which windows they leave open.

name: Desmond
text: [delighted] Your turn to worry, man.
spokenText: [delighted] Your turn to worry, man.

name: Winston
before: [flat] Loud. Sawa — fine. The one with the horns is a sergeant; the rest look to him. Kill him first and they look to nobody.
text: [flat] Loud, then. The one with the horns is the sergeant. Take him first, man. He's giving the orders.
spokenText: [flat] Loud, then. The one with the horns is the sergeant. Take him first, man. He's giving the orders.

name: Winston
before: [flat] Doorman. Leave him to me. Everybody has a price, and his is written on his face.
text: [flat] Let me speak to him. He's watching our purses, man. I doubt he needs much persuading.
spokenText: [flat] Let me speak to him. He's watching our purses, man. I doubt he needs much persuading.

name: Winston
text: [flat] Mind the blade. It's coated.
spokenText: [flat] Mind the blade. It's coated.

name: Santiago
text: [earnest] Behind my shield. Stay close.
spokenText: [earnest] Behind my shield. Stay close.

name: Santiago
text: [strained] Flame preserve us. That was close.
spokenText: [strained] Flame preserve us. That was close.

name: Santiago
text: [firm] Keep back while I raise the ward.
spokenText: [firm] Keep back while I raise the ward.

name: Beau
text: [low] Go on. S-speak. I will watch the guards.
spokenText: [low] Go on. S-speak. I will watch the guards.

name: Beau
text: [steady] B-behind me. Plenty of room.
spokenText: [steady] B-behind me. Plenty of room.

name: Beau
text: [grunting] Sword arm free. Stand clear.
spokenText: [grunting] Sword arm free. Stand clear.

name: Delphine
before: [quiet] He believed it. Third floor. Don't touch anything.
text: [quiet] Upstairs, honey. Third floor. Leave the ornaments alone till we're past his guards.
spokenText: [quiet] Upstairs, honey. Third floor. Leave the ornaments alone till we're past his guards.

name: Delphine
before: [sharp] Two of 'em — and the real Hiwot was BEHIND it, {target}, you cut her — she's breathing. She's breathing. She ain't walking out of here on her own.
text: [sharp] Stop swinging, {target}! You caught the real girl behind it. She's breathing, but she can't walk. Give me room.
spokenText: [sharp] Stop swinging! You caught the real girl behind it. She's breathing, but she can't walk. Give me room.

name: Delphine
text: [calm] Easy, sugar. I've got a little healing left.
spokenText: [calm] Easy, sugar. I've got a little healing left.

name: Itsuki
text: [quiet] Clear my shot.
spokenText: [quiet] Clear my shot.

name: Itsuki
text: [low] Stay below my bow.
spokenText: [low] Stay below my bow.

name: Itsuki
text: [precise] Wait. I have a clear line now.
spokenText: [precise] Wait. I have a clear line now.

name: Bahadır
text: [angry] Chains. Vallahi. We are not leaving those people down there.
spokenText: [angry] Chains. Vallahi. We are not leaving those people down there.

name: Bahadır
text: [booming] Stand back, canım. I need room to swing!
spokenText: [booming] Stand back, canım. I need room to swing!

name: Bahadır
text: [roaring] You will need more than that!
spokenText: [roaring] You will need more than that!

name: Yasemin
text: [precise] Morrak's blood. At the cage I could only tell something had been worshipped. Now we know whose.
spokenText: [precise] The murder god's blood. At the cage I could only tell something had been worshipped. Now we know whose.

name: Yasemin
text: [low] Your aura is flaring here again. Stay beside me, canım. Tell me if you feel it pulling.
spokenText: [low] Your aura is flaring here again. Stay beside me, canım. Tell me if you feel it pulling.

name: Yasemin
text: [dry] A little room, canım. These fans are not decorative.
spokenText: [dry] A little room, canım. These fans are not decorative.

name: Devendra
text: [measured] The clerks will know where the records are. Do try asking before threatening them.
spokenText: [measured] The clerks will know where the records are. Do try asking before threatening them.

name: Devendra
text: [disdainful] Must you stand in front of my staff?
spokenText: [disdainful] Must you stand in front of my staff?

name: Devendra
text: [cool] Move aside. I have a spell prepared.
spokenText: [cool] Move aside. I have a spell prepared.

name: Layla
before: [approving] Ruthless. Correct. The real one is breathing behind it; someone drag her out.
text: [approving] The double is down. Your sister was behind it; you struck her too. She still breathes. Someone carry her.
spokenText: [approving] The double is down. Your sister was behind it; you struck her too. She still breathes. Someone carry her.

name: Layla
before: [sharp] That is not your kin. Kill it before it kisses you.
text: [sharp] Stop listening to that thing. Kill it before it reaches you.
spokenText: [sharp] Stop listening to that thing. Kill it before it reaches you.

name: Layla
text: [cool] Stand still if you want my help.
spokenText: [cool] Stand still if you want my help.

name: Kaito
before: [appraising] Not bounty hunters; you walk too close together. A green sash — Wardens, then, or with Wardens. Good. Wardens cut people down for nothing. Kaito. I hunt bounties, mostly, and I was hunting a wyvern's head when the spiders took offence.
text: [appraising] A green sash. Wardens, or travelling with them? Good. You cut people out of webs without charging, I hope. Kaito. Bounty hunter. I came for a wyvern and found spiders instead.
spokenText: [appraising] A green sash. Wardens, or travelling with them? Good. You cut people out of webs without charging, I hope. Bounty hunter. I came for a wyvern and found spiders instead.

name: Kaito
before: [smiling] He believed it. Third floor. Touch nothing, he says — as if.
text: [smiling] Third floor. Yes, of course. I shall keep my hands where the gentleman can see them.
spokenText: [smiling] Third floor. Yes, of course. I shall keep my hands where the gentleman can see them.

name: Kaito
before: [smiling] Loosing, loosing — got him, and he was handsome, too. A pity.
text: [smiling] Got him. Handsome fellow, too. What a pity.
spokenText: [smiling] Got him. Handsome fellow, too. What a pity.

name: Wanjiru
text: [hard] So this is where the iron goes. Look how much of it they put on one gate.
spokenText: [hard] So this is where the iron goes. Look how much of it they put on one gate.

name: Wanjiru
text: [fierce] Hit the thorns. Go on.
spokenText: [fierce] Hit the thorns. Go on.

name: Wanjiru
text: [low] Sawa. Stay close while I cast.
spokenText: [low] Sawa. Stay close while I cast.

name: Dai Morgan
before: [grunting] Third floor. Don't touch anything. Good advice for a tower, that.
text: [grunting] Three floors up. Aye. Keep off the fittings, bach. No sense giving him a reason to call us back.
spokenText: [grunting] Three floors up. Aye. Keep off the fittings, bach. No sense giving him a reason to call us back.

name: Dai Morgan
text: [gravelly] Old stone below new stone. Mind the joins, bach. Water gets between them.
spokenText: [gravelly] Old stone below new stone. Mind the joins, bach. Water gets between them.

name: Dai Morgan
text: [calm] Hold still, bach. I'll mend that.
spokenText: [calm] Hold still, bach. I'll mend that.

name: Amara
text: [exact] Leave room for my second blade.
spokenText: [exact] Leave room for my second blade.

name: Amara
text: [steady] Keep your guard. I will take this side.
spokenText: [steady] Keep your guard. I will take this side.

name: Amara
text: [quiet] Watch my hands. Move when I move.
spokenText: [quiet] Watch my hands. Move when I move.
